title: The read after a sync that found no live file moved still gets the last fingerprint and database, so a sync with nothing changed answers in seconds instead of reading the whole site
steps: S1: node --test --test-name-pattern="did not move since the import" packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/live-sync-flow.test.mjs
expect: S1: the first sync takes the import as the live files' tree; the next read is handed the last fingerprint and database with no manifest, and answers unchanged by fingerprint
fence: A sync that read no file never makes the next one read the whole live site
